label: copy-phase input "o" fed back at recall positions 2-4 (not last output)
explanation: Token-specific copy-phase feature: fires only when the input is the letter o during the copy phase (o fed back as the previous output, i.e. original tokens 1-3 being o). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, nor on any other input token. Strongest when o is the second original token (recall_idx 2, step right after DEL+first token; ~60% of mass, all top examples), weaker at recall_idx 3, weak at 4, near zero at recall_idx 1 (o as first token) and >=5. Does not fire on the final copy step (to_go 0). Magnitude not modulated by out_tok/next_out/prev_tok. Simple (phase==2)&(in_tok==o) gets ~100% recall but 0.42 precision because of late positions.

issues: The reported test scores match when re-run (P 0.904, R 0.970, F1 0.936, mass recall 0.997).
Phase and token claims hold. Every activation is in the copy phase: 0 active steps in the original or delimiter phase. o accounts for 38277 of 38282 active steps; b, s and g have 1-2 stray hits each.

The recall_idx mass claims hold: 0.596 at idx 2, 0.356 at idx 3, 0.044 at idx 4, 0.003 at idx 1, and about 0 at idx 5 and later. The to_go=0 claim also holds: o at recall_idx 3 with L=4 (the final step) has precision 0.002 over 2407 steps. Precision is about 1.0 at recall_idx 2 and 3 for every L.

Almost all false positives (about 3.9k) come from recall_idx 4. There the feature fires only about 65% of the time: 0.42 at to_go=1 (L=6), and 0.68-0.76 for L=7-9. Slicing this band by to_go, correct, in_count, n_digits, prev_tok and prev2_tok (digit or vowel), orig(0) and next_out found no selector. It is a weak, partly firing band rather than a systematic counterexample class, and the explanation already says idx 4 is weak.
The missed activations hold 0.3% of the mass and are tiny: mostly o as the first original token (recall_idx 1, activation 0.0-0.2), plus a few late positions.

Alternative predicates do not help much. Restricting to recall_idx 2-3 raises precision to 0.999 but cuts test F1 to 0.878. Also excluding recall_idx 4 at to_go 1 gives test F1 0.938, a negligible gain. The original predicate is essentially as good as possible.
